headline: Executive order from 1994 dealing with the North Pacific Marine Science Organization, an international ocean science group.
what_it_does: This order concerns the North Pacific Marine Science Organization, an international group that studies the northern Pacific Ocean. Only the title was provided, so the exact details are not confirmed here. Orders like this one usually give an international group certain legal protections and privileges in the United States under the International Organizations Immunities Act.

who_it_affects.group: The North Pacific Marine Science Organization and its staff
who_it_affects.how: The order likely gives the group legal standing and protections in the United States, such as some immunity from lawsuits and taxes.
